items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: But when I saw Pete, when Pete came back to Paris, he said -- well, I'm glad -- well, I explained to him that I'd gotten a wire from Canetti and everything... So, I told him, I said that in any case, I said, 'You don't have to worry, I would never do such a thing.'

ctx.x: She was married to t du Conge?
Yes. She had lived with us. Bricktop was Pete's wife.
Oh, is that right, I didn't know that.
